management_major_statements.value: The company describes ALT-B4 (berahyaluronidase alfa) as its core asset for converting IV biologics to SC formulations and states that it has license arrangements with MSD/Merck, AstraZeneca, Sanofi, GSK, Daiichi Sankyo, Sandoz, Biogen and Intas.

Revenue recognition for license arrangements can be based on upfront payments, milestones, royalties and progress-based technical services under K-IFRS 1115; invoiced amount and recognized revenue can differ where progress-based recognition applies.

risk_related_disclosures.value: License agreements generally provide that clinical, registration or commercialization failure can terminate the agreement; the filing states that such termination does not create a penalty-payment obligation for Alteogen in the disclosed contract terms.

At 2026-06-30, the financial-liability cash-flow table includes KRW 158.330bn of redemption-convertible-preferred-share liability and KRW 2.080bn of convertible-bond cash flow on an undiscounted basis.

The parent provides a KRW 1.0bn pledged deposit with a KRW 1.1bn secured amount to Hana Bank in connection with a guarantee for Alteogen Biologics. The FY2025 report shows the same substantive guarantee structure dated 2025-03-04; H1 2026 shows a 2026-03-04 guarantee date.
